message: さようなら
--Only one day left until parting with Lolotte.

name: Synn
message: 「All right, all right!」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Whoa~~. That's a huge spotlight~~」

name: Synn
message: 「Apparently Helena-san shelled out a fortune for it, saying something like, 'Do not underestimate the financial might of the Kujou family!'」

name: Melilot
message: 「Good grief... She must be mistaking this tower for some kind of sideshow.」

name: Helena
message: 「Well, come on~~. Re-Crea is finally over without a hitch, so I want to throw a big, flashy celebration! Real flashy!!」

name: Melilot
message: 「You're always using that as an excuse just to drink!!」

name: Helena
message: 「Today is special!! Right, Synn-chan?♪」

name: Synn
message: 「It is the Holy Night Festival, after all!」

name: Helena
message: 「Hey, hey, how are the costumes coming along?」

name: Synn
message: 「We're taking sign-ups at the reception desk for anyone who wants one. We've got a whole lineup of our finest creations, so please pick whichever you like.」

name: Helena
message: 「Really!?」

name: Lolotte
message: 「I especially recommend the bunny girl outfit.」

name: Helena
message: 「Oh my! That would look great on Melilot!」

name: Melilot
message: 「I am never wearing that!」

name: Helena
message: 「Ufufu\s04 Well then, Synn-chan... I'll be looking forward to the main event.」

name: Synn
message: 「Yes! See you later, then.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Please enjoy yourselves to the fullest, you two~~」

name: Helena
message: 「You too!」

name: Melilot
message: 「Until later.」

name: Synn
message: 「Hey, Lolotte. Do you have any other errands today... until the Holy Night Festival?」

name: Lolotte
message: 「No♪ Today, I'll be with you... the whole time\s04」

name: Synn
message: 「A-All right! Then today, we're sticking together from start to finish! Let's get right on the next preparations!」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Okay, let's go~♪」

name: Ria
message: 「One, two, three. One, two, th--」

name: Ria
message: 「Waaah!!」

name: Misasagi
message: 「That won't do at all, Ria. Your rhythm is all over the place」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Senpai~~!!」

name: Synn
message: 「H-Huh? Why are the two of you hugging...」

name: Misasagi
message: 「Whatever are you misunderstanding? This is dance practice, you know」

name: Synn
message: 「I didn't mean it in any weird way!\s01」

name: Lolotte
message: 「It's just that, with the two of your skills, I assumed you would be dancing much more gracefully」

name: Misasagi
message: 「No matter how skilled a person is, everyone makes a mistake once in a while」

name: Ria
message: 「Ahaha...\s02」

name: Ria
message: 「Speaking of which, have you two gotten the hang of dancing properly?」

name: Synn
message: 「W-Well, about that...」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Ehehe~\s02」

name: Misasagi
message: 「We aren't doing anything terribly difficult, so why don't you practice starting right now?」

name: Lolotte
message: 「That's a brilliant idea!! Well then, President, let's get started right away!」

name: Synn
message: 「Y-Yeah. Though, I... really don't know much about dancing...」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Don't we have two wonderful teachers standing right in front of us!」

name: Misasagi
message: 「Two... huh」

name: Ria
message: 「J-Jeez! Even I can manage a little bit, you know!」

name: Synn
message: 「You don't need to be so modest and say 'a little bit'」

name: Ria
message: 「Uuu~~」

name: Misasagi
message: 「Heehee. Now then, Lolotte. May I have your hand?」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Yes♪」

name: Misasagi
message: 「Let's keep it brief, so the President doesn't get jealous」

name: Synn
message: 「I'm not getting jealous or anything!」

name: Lolotte
message: 「You don't need to worry. My heart is completely full of you, President.」

name: Misasagi
message: 「Oh my. You two certainly are lovey-dovey, aren't you?」

name: Ria
message: 「Ahaha... Thanks for the sweet show\s02」

name: Synn
message: 「I-I told you, I'm not jealous...」

name: Misasagi
message: 「In that case, President, please pair up with Ria.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「I'm putting a stop to that!」

name: Synn
message: 「Huh?」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Once I've mastered it, I'll teach the President plenty myself.」

name: Misasagi
message: 「Heehee... It seems Lolotte is the one getting jealous.」

name: Synn
message: 「S-So that's what it was--」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Wh-Wha?! That's not true at all~~!\s01」

name: Ria
message: 「Come on, Akane-chan. If you keep teasing them, we'll run out of time.」

name: Misasagi
message: 「My apologies. Let's start right away on one, two, three.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Wh-Whoa! My feet, my feet--!」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Fueee~~\s06」

name: Ria
message: 「Oh dear~~\s02」

name: Misasagi
message: 「We haven't even started yet\s02」

name: Synn
message: 「Guess dancing is off the table until next year's Holy Night Festival.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Geez! I said I'll be fine! I'll definitely pull it off!」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Things didn't go quite that easily...」

name: Synn
message: 「You don't have to do anything formal--just get into the groove with the music and you'll be fine.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「I see, get into the groove!」

name: Misa
message: 「Oh my, Sakura-kun and Lolotte-san!」

name: Synn
message: 「Looks like choir preparations are going smoothly」

name: Misa
message: 「Yes, of course! I never leave anything to chance」

name: Misa
message: 「Did you make sure to teach Amyrina-san properly too?」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Yes! She really loved this song!」

name: Misa
message: 「Oh, wonderful♪」

name: Shio
message: 「Sob, sob...」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Oh dear, Shrine Maiden. Whatever is the matter?」

name: Shio
message: 「I... am rather poor at such delicate, high-pitched songs」

name: Misa
message: 「What are you talking about? I'm counting on you to be our soprano leader」

name: Shio
message: 「W-What!! You tell me to humiliate myself!?」

name: Lolotte
message: 「It only becomes humiliating because you think of it as humiliating」

name: Lolotte
message: 「After all, people always say, 'Throw shame to the wind and kindness rules the world'!」

name: Shio
message: 「They do not!」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Huh, how strange」

name: Synn
message: 「Guidebooks really do get a lot of idioms wrong, huh」

name: Lolotte
message: 「I-Is that sooo」

name: Misa
message: 「Heehee. You're reacting just like Sakura-kun」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Incidentally, how would one express it in a situation like this?」

name: Synn
message: 「U-Ummm. 'Do your best!' maybe」

name: Misa
message: 「That's not an idiom, you know」

name: Synn
message: 「Urk」

name: Lolotte
message: 「It's alright. No matter how tone-deaf and terrible at singing you are, if it's you, Shrine Maiden, I'm sure you can do it!」

name: Shio
message: 「Lord Lolotte...」

name: Shio
message: 「More importantly, do not go assuming I am bad at it on your own!」

name: Misa
message: 「What about you, Lolotte? Do you actually remember it properly?」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Of course, I've got it down pat! I committed every single word to memory!」

name: Shio
message: 「In that case, even after you return to Heaven, you will be able to sing it for the other angels--」

name: Misa
message: 「S-Shio!\s01」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Shrine Maiden... That's a wonderful idea!」

name: Synn
message: 「Yeah. Go ahead and brag about Human World songs too!」

name: Shio
message: 「Y-You two...」

name: Misa
message: 「...You're right. After all, Lolotte is going to come back.」

name: Misa
message: 「Then we'll have to make sure Amyrina and Azel can sing along in a grand chorus!」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Amyrina aside, Azel didn't seem to remember any of it at all, though.」

name: Misa
message: 「Geez, that girl!」

name: Synn
message: 「Ahaha, Azel only ever listens to what you say anyway, Lolotte.」

name: Misa
message: 「In that case, you'll have to drill it into her head properly while you're in Heaven, Lolotte.」

name: Misa
message: 「So that even prettier singing voices will echo through next year's Holy Night Festival!」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Understood, Captain!」

name: Synn
message: 「Now then, let's see how the Sweets Club is doing...」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Oh my...? Something smells delicious~\s07」

name: Sacchin
message: 「Ah, it's Synn!」

name: Synn
message: 「How's the cake-making going?」

name: Sacchin
message: 「Going great, of course♪ After all, we've got a sweets expert giving us super detailed instructions~」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Sacchin! Less moving your mouth, more moving your hands!」

name: Sacchin
message: 「Waaah!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Welcome, you two」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Huh? Aren't you making a cake too, Treasurer?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「O-Oh, I'm... pretty clumsy, so I'm just helping out...」

name: Synn
message: 「I don't think Sacchin is any less clumsy, though...」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Oh, right! Wanna try making one too, Lolo-chan?」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Of course! That is the whole reason I came, after all!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Reaally~? Didn't you actually come just to sneak some tastes?」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Ehehe~. I'm no match for you, Treasurer~」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Then come on, Lolo-chan. Let's taste-test the sweets Sacchin made for us」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Yes, by all means!」

name: Synn
message: 「Then count me in too!」

name: Paqy
message: 「The great me will pass on that」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Why?」

name: Paqy
message: 「Call it the intuition of a Great Sage」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Don't say that--come be a human sacrifice along with us~」

name: Paqy
message: 「Do you even know what that word means?」

name: Sacchin
message: 「Hii, thanks for waiting~ Prototype Number One is all done~♪」

name: Synn
message: 「Number One!? You didn't practice beforehand!?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Of course not! In theory, though, it should turn out great--probably!」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Ooh~. So it's the classic 'looks questionable, tastes surprisingly good' sort of thing, is it?」

name: Synn
message: 「By the way, did you taste-test it?」

name: Sacchin
message: 「I can't go sneaking bites out of something I'm serving to guests~」

name: Paqy
message: 「Just as I thought」

name: Synn
message: 「Still, I believe in Nanaka and Sacchin!」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Well then, let's dig in♪」

name: Paqy
message: 「My condolences...」

name: Sacchin
message: 「Ahaha. Whoops, I messed up. Maybe adding my own little twist was a bad idea?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Sacchin! You're perfectly capable if you just follow the instructions, so why!?」

name: Sacchin
message: 「Well, you can't do it either, right, Nana-chan?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Urk...! Still, at this rate the Holy Night Festival is going to start, I have to do something!」

name: Misa
message: 「Good grief... I can't bear to watch this」

name: Ria
message: 「Now is the time for the Crusaders to step in... maybe?」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Ooh, reinforcements!! If everyone combines their strength, we can definitely do it! It'll be okay!」

name: Synn
message: 「Alright, let's push right up until the last minute!」

name: Everyone
message: 「Yeah--!」
As the Ryuusei Student Council.
Even though this might be our very last activity as the Ryuusei Crusaders.
You'd never know it from the way everyone comes together so naturally, as if it were the most normal thing in the world.
It was a moment where I witnessed firsthand the strength of the bonds we had built up until now.
Preparations are completely ready, and then--
Slowly, the light fades from the sky.
In its place, small lights flicker on across the many lamps surrounding Finis Tower.
Before long, our Holy Night Festival will announce its beginning.
And to Amyrina and Azel--
We will say goodbye to Lolotte.

name: Amyrina
message: 「Lolotte!」

name: Lolotte
message: 「I've been waiting for you!」

name: Azel
message: 「Sorry I'm late」

name: Lolotte
message: 「It's fine. More importantly, how are you feeling?」

name: Azel
message: 「Yeah. I'm just a bit out of shape from lying down too much. I suppose I should have done a little rehab」

name: Amyrina
message: 「It's alright. After all, we were practicing singing together while Lolotte was at school」

name: Azel
message: 「W-We promised to keep that a secret, didn't we!」

name: Amyrina
message: 「After all, I couldn't possibly keep something this wonderful a secret♪」

name: Synn
message: 「Were you planning to surprise me, by any chance?」

name: Azel
message: 「I-I would never do something so childish.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Teehee. I'm sure the Vice President will be thrilled too. Let's make this song one of our souvenirs to bring back to Heaven♪」

name: Synn
message: 「Make sure to bring back plenty of wonderful memories as souvenirs too, okay?」

name: Amyrina
message: 「Mr. President...」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Now, now, Amyrina. Today is all about making memories overflowing with smiles.」

name: Amyrina
message: 「I-I'm sorry!\s01」

name: Synn
message: 「Enjoy the Holy Night Festival to the fullest, okay?」

name: Amyrina
message: 「Y-Yes!」

name: Azel
message: 「Are... stars still shooting across the sky?」

name: Synn
message: 「Yeah.」

name: Azel
message: 「I see...」

name: Lolotte
message: 「The grounds are pitch-black, but the shooting stars light things up enough that we can spot our destination right away!」

name: Azel
message: 「Toward Finis Tower... So Re-Crea is returning once again.」

name: Synn
message: 「Finis Tower really is...」

name: Azel
message: 「According to that librarian, Melilot, much of it still remains unexplained.」

name: Azel
message: 「The origin of Re-Crea... The reason I was guided to this academy must also lie in how everything centers around that tower.」

name: Azel
message: 「It is also said to be a colossal pillar spanning the three realms. It may well extend not only across the surface, but deep underground as well.」

name: Azel
message: 「Though all of those have only been passed down as fairy tales.」

name: Synn
message: 「So in reality, it's completely shrouded in mystery, huh?」

name: Lolotte
message: 「A tower full of mysteries... How exciting! I'd love to go on an adventure there someday!」

name: Azel
message: 「In Finis Tower... you mean?」

name: Synn
message: 「Maybe there's a princess locked away on the top floor, or some incredible treasure sleeping up there!」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Ooh!! We simply must go to this!」

name: Azel
message: 「You've been playing too many video games」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Please don't shoot me down with such an unromantic remark while smiling warmly」

name: Azel
message: 「Lolotte... About returning home... I'm really sorry」

name: Lolotte
message: 「It's completely fine. We're only leaving the Human World unattended for a little while, after all」

name: Riesling
message: 「Please leave watching the house to me, Riesling Tooyama」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Come on, Jeeves! Stop striking weird poses and come with us」

name: Synn
message: 「Why are you pointing a gun at me!?」

name: Riesling
message: 「You are, so to speak, one in body and soul with Milady. In Milady's stead, I shall silence that mouth--」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Come on! If we don't hurry, we're going to miss the opening ceremony」
Drag, drag, drag... Riesling-san gets hauled away.
As she picked up speed, he was even floating in midair.
Ah, so that's how I always looked whenever I was with Lolotte...
Although a large crowd had gathered, the lighting still wasn't fully up yet.
Everyone was waiting with bated breath for things to start.

name: Nanaka
message: 「Well, nothing can start until the person giving the opening signal gets here」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Oh...? Wasn't making announcements always the Vice President's duty?」

name: Misa
message: 「Lolotte-san. Have you ever thought you'd like to try speaking over the microphone?」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Yes, of course I have! In fact, I feel like snatching it away every single time!」

name: Lolotte
message: 「However, if I did that, it would undermine the Vice President's position...」

name: Misa
message: 「Rest assured! I have plenty of other duties to handle!」

name: Ria
message: 「The Holy Night Festival is going to start on your signal, Lolotte-chan」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Huh... Are you really sure that's alright?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Come on, come on. Everyone's craning their necks waiting for you」

name: Synn
message: 「You've got this, Lolotte!」

name: Lolotte
message: 「From this moment on, the Ryuusei Academy Holy Night Festival officially begins!」
Fun times always seem to pass by in the blink of an eye.
As the Holy Night Festival program progressed one event at a time, a single shooting star fell from the sky.
And then another.
Vanishing into the sky, never to appear again.
Before long, the sky was overwhelmed and filled by the light of the Holy Night Festival illuminations.
Unnoticed, the shooting stars had disappeared from the sky.
It signaled the end of Re-Crea, as well as the curtain call of the Holy Night Festival.
Soon, Lolotte would return to Heaven with an armful of memories.
The moment of farewell drew nearer with every passing second.

name: Lolotte
message: 「It's already over, isn't it...」

name: Synn
message: 「Yeah...」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Mr. President... Could you dance with me just one more time?」

name: Synn
message: 「Sure, of course.」
Along with the gentle outro,
As though the fact that Lolotte would return to Heaven right after this were all a lie.
Even though she was right beside me, smiling in my arms.
To think that Lolotte, who was right here so close to me--
Would disappear from before my eyes.
So much so
So much so
That it was almost unbelievable--
I was completely filled to the brim with thoughts of Lolotte.

name: Lolotte
message: 「I'm also... completely filled with thoughts of you, Mr. President...」

name: Lolotte
message: 「The fun times, and the happy times. The sad times, and the painful times. Every single day I spent with you and everyone else is packed right inside.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Truly... I don't even know... how to thank you all」

name: Synn
message: 「You don't need to worry about that... After all, you gave us plenty of energy and cheer too, Lolotte.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「I have to say goodbye to everyone」
Even after the Holy Night Festival ended, everyone from the Student Council and those with ties to Lolotte remained behind.
Just as Azel intended, the angels would return to Heaven once the Holy Night Festival was over.
It might very well be the last time.
Even so, not a single person doubted they would meet again.
Still, losing someone who had always been right there with them inevitably carried a lingering sense of loneliness.
Even if we meet again, our time with Lolotte stops right here.

name: Sally
message: 「Loro-chi, are you really leaving?」

name: Lolotte
message: 「There is no need to be sad. I will be back before you know it.」

name: Sally
message: 「Really? You promise it's true?」

name: Lolotte
message: 「An angel never goes back on her word. Please believe me.」

name: Sally
message: 「Uuu~~」

name: Nanaka
message: 「There, there, don't cry」

name: Sally
message: 「B-But, buuut~~! Waaaaah!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Come on... don't cry like that, Sally-chan. Or else I won't... be able to hold back either...!」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Treasurer...」

name: Shio
message: 「Lady Lolotte... hold your head high. An angel is, after all, a messenger from Heaven.」

name: Misa
message: 「Put in a good word for the Human World, okay?」

name: Lolotte
message: 「...Yes! Leave it to me!」

name: Misasagi
message: 「We're graduatin' soon, so I dunno if we'll see ya at school again, but...」

name: Ria
message: 「Even so, let's stay friends forever, okay? ♪」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Of course!」

name: Sacchin
message: 「When you get back, let's go sweets-hopping together again~」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Yes! I'm looking forward to it!」

name: Melilot
message: 「Some things can only be understood once you're apart. There's no need to take every farewell as something negative.」

name: Helena
message: 「It also gives us something new to look forward to--seeing each other again. So it isn't a sad thing」

name: Lolotte
message: 「You two really are so mature」

name: Helena
message: 「Not at all. Even if we say things like that, lonely is still lonely」

name: Helena
message: 「It's going to be lonely for a while, isn't it? For both of us」

name: Lolotte
message: 「I'll be fine. Amyrina and Azel-san will be with me, after all.」

name: Melilot
message: 「Please don't forget, though. Even if we're apart, there are so many people who care about you.」

name: Riesling
message: 「My lady...」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Jiiya...」

name: Riesling
message: 「I, Riesling Tooyama, believed my tears had dried up long ago.」

name: Riesling
message: 「Yet ever since meeting you, my lady, I have been gradually changing...」

name: Riesling
message: 「Even though this change is a joyful thing」

name: Riesling
message: 「Right now, because of these emotions... I cannot hold back the feeling of not wanting to part from you...」

name: Riesling
message: 「They've come overflowing out...」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Jiiya...」
Lolotte wrapped Riesling-san in a gentle hug and softly stroked his head.

name: Lolotte
message: 「Whenever I was alone and crying from loneliness, you always comforted me just like this, didn't you, Jiiya...」

name: Riesling
message: 「My lady...」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Jiiya, you have wonderful friends like the Chairwoman and the Librarian too.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「And Grandfather and Grandmother as well... Everyone thinks of you as family too, Jiiya.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「I know I'll be making you feel lonely for just a little while, so please wait for me.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「And I'll work hard... so that I can live together with you again, Jiiya!」

name: Riesling
message: 「My lady... my lady...」
Lolotte took a wool scarf from her coat and wrapped it around the neck of Riesling-san, who was trembling with sobs.

name: Riesling
message: 「Th-This is...」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Though I don't suppose you'll be all that surprised, Jiiya.」

name: Riesling
message: 「Th-There shouldn't have been one in this color... When did you...」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Heehee. Contrary to how it looks, I was keeping a close eye out for your blind spots, Jiiya.」

name: Riesling
message: 「To slip right past the eyes of Riesling Tooyama...」

name: Lolotte
message: 「This matches the ones for Grandfather and Grandmother. Please wear them together and get along nicely, okay?」

name: Riesling
message: 「Thank you very much... I will treasure it for the rest of my life」

name: Amyrina
message: 「Lolotte, give these to everyone」

name: Azel
message: 「Come on, these are getting heavy」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Awawa, I'm so sorry!\s01」
Amyrina and Azel hurried over to Lolotte and handed her the paper bags.

name: Lolotte
message: 「I have... a present from me to everyone who has helped me so much!」
Yarn in a variety of colors burst forth from the paper bags.
They were all shaped like scarves, each accompanied by a little pig mascot as a bonus.
Naturally, they were modeled after Tontoro.

name: Lolotte
message: 「Here you go, Madam Treasurer」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Is this...」

name: Lolotte
message: 「And one for you too, Vice President♪」

name: Misa
message: 「A hand-knitted scarf!?」

name: Lolotte
message: 「And this one is for you, Senpai」

name: Ria
message: 「Huh... this is for me...?」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Bonus-san. You mustn't wipe your tears with this, okay? It'll be scratchy」

name: Sally
message: 「Lolo-chi~~. Lolo-chii~~\s06」

name: Lolotte
message: 「I made one for you too, Sacchin-san」

name: Sacchin
message: 「Yay, thanks!」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Of course, one for you too, Shrine Maiden-san」

name: Shio
message: 「To think you would bestow one even upon this humble self... I am moved beyond measure!」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Would this be a bit too childish for you, Misasagi-san...?」

name: Misasagi
message: 「Not at all, dear. Thank you kindly. I'll take good care of it」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Though, I suppose for the two of you...」

name: Helena
message: 「What are you talking about? We're both still plenty young, aren't we?」

name: Melilot
message: 「Ahem, ahem...」

name: Lolotte
message: 「I made every single one of these while thinking of you all. I'm sure they're packed full of those feelings」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Lolo-chan... I'm gonna treasure this!」

name: Misa
message: 「Oh, how adorable...\s04」

name: Ria
message: 「Heehee. With this scarf, I feel like Lolotte-chan's face will pop right into my head」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Thanks!」

name: Misa
message: 「Thank you」

name: Ria
message: 「Thank you so much♪」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Not at all. I'm just glad you're all pleased with them」

name: Paqy
message: 「Kukuku... Classic move, angel. Keeping the main attraction--our Demon Lord--waiting in suspense, huh」

name: Synn
message: 「Sh-Shut up」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Geez, for a Mr. Panda who says such mean things, take this!」

name: Paqy
message: 「Mgyah!!」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Heehee. Maybe it was a little too big for Mr. Panda」

name: Paqy
message: 「C-Can't... breathe...」

name: Lolotte
message: 「President... Thank you for waiting」

name: Synn
message: 「N-No, not at all...」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Yours is a little bit special, President. Heave-ho, heave-ho」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Ta-daa. Here you go~~」

name: Synn
message: 「H-Huh... Mine's a bit different from everyone else's scarves」
It's a size longer than a normal scarf.

name: Nanaka
message: 「Doesn't that just mean you're supposed to wrap it around your neck a bunch of times? Looks super warm」

name: Misa
message: 「Good grief, you don't have a romantic bone in your body, do you, Nanaka-san\s10」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Wha--what did you say!?」

name: Misa
message: 「This was made with the wish that it would reach all the way to Heaven...\s07」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Hmm~~ Close, Vice President. That's a little off」

name: Misa
message: 「Eh」

name: Ria
message: 「I'm sure of it. This scarf includes Lolotte-chan's share too」

name: Synn
message: 「I see...」
My chest swells with welling emotion.

name: Lolotte
message: 「For a little while, the scarf will stay extra long, but... I know the day will come when the two of us can wear it together」

name: Synn
message: 「Lolotte... I'll look forward to that day and take good care of it!」
With the scarf still clutched in my hand, I pulled Lolotte into an embrace.

name: Lolotte
message: 「Ehehe... You're nice and warm even without a scarf, President...」

name: Synn
message: 「Lolotte... thank you. For staying by my side... all this time... thank you」
The urge to stay like this, holding each other forever, grows stronger.
Still, we've endured everything up to this point without shedding a single tear.
Hiding away the pain of parting, keeping smiles on our faces while we're still together.
So that when we meet again, we can greet each other with smiles too.

name: Lolotte
message: 「Everyone, thank you so much for everything up until now」

name: Lolotte
message: 「You've all been so kind to me... Being surrounded by such wonderful people, I... was truly happy!」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Now... I have no regrets left」

name: Synn
message: 「Wait, Lolotte!」

name: Lolotte
message: 「P-President...?」

name: Synn
message: 「Actually... I have a present for you too」

name: Synn
message: 「If I'm giving something to you, Lolotte, I figured this would be the very best thing...」
I pulled out a small box I'd kept tucked away in my pocket.
When I opened the lid, what appeared inside was a ring, glittering under the lights.

name: Synn
message: 「Lolotte, hold out your hand」
As if drawn in, Lolotte extends her hand.
Gently enveloping that small hand in mine, I savor its warmth and feel.
Even if these hands part, our hearts never will.
Pouring that steadfast wish into it, I slip the ring of our vow onto Lolotte's finger.

name: Lolotte
message: 「Waaah...」
Lolotte holds her hand up, gazing intently at the shape of the ring.

name: Synn
message: 「This is a present from me」
I also held my hand up the same way, placing it over the back of Lolotte's hand.

name: Synn
message: 「With this ring, no matter how far apart we are, we'll always be connected」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Always...」

name: Synn
message: 「That's why, no matter what... I wanted to give you a present, Lolotte...」

name: Synn
message: 「W-What do you think... do you like it?」

name: Lolotte
message: 「No matter... how far... apart we are... We'll always... always... be connected...」

name: Synn
message: 「Lolotte...?」

name: Lolotte
message: 「...I'm happy... I'm so happy... truly, so happy... Your kindness, President...」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Like this, I... can't... hold back anymore...!」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Even though I swore I wouldn't cry... even though I decided I'd definitely say goodbye with a smile...!」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Uhh... ughh, uwaaaah, aaaaah!!」

name: Synn
message: 「Lolotte...!」
I tightly embraced Lolotte as she broke down crying.
I'm lonely after all. I don't want to part.
We hadn't grown up enough yet to hide those feelings.
Even if we acted like adults, even if we imitated adults, we still held young, fragile hearts inside.
When night comes, I feel like I'll be crushed by the anxiety that we might never see each other again.
Still, if we don't overcome this sadness.
We'll remain nothing more than children forever.
The future we're going to build cannot stop right here.
As if representing Lolotte, who has always charged forward recklessly.
That's the Lolotte I love.
So, this farewell isn't the end.
It's the beginning of our new future!
A cold wind brushes past our tear-stained cheeks.
Aside from the tears spilling from the corners of our eyes, wetting our cheeks--
White fairies fluttering down as if to cover our tears of sorrow.

name: Lolotte
message: 「This is...」

name: Synn
message: 「It's snow...!」
The snow, which should have been cold, felt somehow warm.

name: Lolotte
message: 「The ring... thank you very much. It's really lovely.」

name: Synn
message: 「I'm glad you like it.」
The two of us looked up at the sky.

name: Lolotte
message: 「So this really is goodbye, isn't it...」

name: Synn
message: 「Yeah... I wonder when we'll see each other again...?」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Maybe it'll be around the time you become an old man, President?」

name: Synn
message: 「Even then, I'll wait...」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Me too...」

name: Lolotte
message: 「No matter how far apart we are, no matter how long we're apart」

name: Lolotte
message: 「The person I love most in the world is you, President!」

name: Synn
message: 「I love you too, Lolotte.」
Letting the snow wipe away our tears, we smile once again.

name: Synn
message: 「Goodbye, Lolotte.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Goodbye, President!」
